baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root appears first as the verb and then as the definite event-name in words 2-3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verbal occurrence makes the nominal Event enact its own name: a severe descent crosses into a fixed, unavoidable actuality.

activation_trace.role: Falling into place and becoming fixed supplies the passage from motion to accomplished actuality.
The severe descending event identifies the definite noun as the named calamitous arrival.

changed_reading.after: When the severe Event descends and becomes established as actuality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal threshold introduced by the opening construction governs the repeated focus root.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase compresses a before-state of expecting or projecting the event and an after-state in which it is registered as impact.

activation_trace.role: Expectation and projected supposition supply the unrealized side of the temporal threshold.
The trace and sound of a hard fall supply the sensory registration that ends mere expectation.

changed_reading.after: The awaited thing crosses its threshold and becomes an unmistakable impact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Negation removes both a counter-version and a lag between prediction and occurrence, strengthening the focus event as actuality that cannot be talked away or deferred.

activation_trace.role: The severe descending event is the focus claim whose actuality is tested by the next ayah.
Categorical negation closes the present-state route by which the occurrence might fail to be actual.
Contradiction of truth supplies the rejected counter-version of the Event.
The no-lingering branch sharpens the rejection of any interval that postpones actualization.

structural_cues: 56:2 repeats the focus root nominally and predicates a negated feminine term of its occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: negation, the repeated event-root, and truth/non-delay branches. Reader: the negation governs both factual reversal and temporal lag. Alternative: it may deny only a false report or denier.

changed_reading.before: The severe event may be imagined as a future possibility.
changed_reading.after: The named event actualizes without a viable counter-account or postponing interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Event becomes a differential placement operator: it lowers and raises, resolves humanity into three classes, and specifies side, precedence, and proximity rather than affecting all positions uniformly.

activation_trace.role: Falling into a place and becoming fixed supplies the focus event's allocative spatial grammar.
Descent after height supplies one directed outcome of the Event.
Elevation supplies the contrary directed outcome and prevents a uniform-collapse model.
A distinct kind or class turns vertical differentiation into social classification.
The number three fixes the classification as a bounded allocation.
Right-side power and right furnish a positively marked destination within the allocation.
The leftward side furnishes the opposed destination within the allocation.
Precedence adds an axial rank not exhausted by the right-left division.
The specially near circle converts precedence into privileged proximity.

structural_cues: The objectless lowering-raising pair in 56:3 is specified by the threefold grouping in 56:7-11.
Repeated class labels and repeated 'forerunners' make placement emphatic rather than incidental.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opposed vertical motions followed by three classes, two sides, precedence, and nearness. Reader: these are successive specifications of one allocative action by the Event. Alternative: 56:3 may describe physical terrain while 56:7-11 begins an independent social scene.

changed_reading.before: The Event is a severe occurrence that lands upon everyone.
changed_reading.after: The Event makes positions fall into a new order, lowering some and raising others into side, rank, and proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: What initially sounded like an event falling onto a stable world becomes failure of the landing substrate itself: earth oscillates, mountain solidity is comminuted, and the result disperses as fine dust.

activation_trace.role: Falling into place and becoming fixed supplies the stability model that the material sequence overturns.
Agitation until oscillation removes rest from the ground on which things ordinarily settle.
The lower surface opposite heaven identifies the affected support layer.
Crumbling, wetting, and mixing supply the loss of coherent mass.
The elevated solid aggregate is the maximal test case for destroyed fixity.
Fine scattered dust supplies the particulate state produced from former solidity.
Broadcast dispersal makes the transformation spatially extensive rather than a local break.

structural_cues: 56:4-5 repeat each transformation as verb plus cognate intensifier.
The sequence runs from oscillation through comminution to airborne dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an ordered material sequence from shaken earth to pulverized mountains to dispersed dust. Reader: the sequence is a causal phase change governed by the focus Event. Alternative: the details may be parallel signs without a single substrate-failure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A calamitous object or blow falls upon a stable world.
changed_reading.after: The Event is the unfixing of the world that normally receives falls: support and elevation alike become mobile particulate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context reverses its own dispersal: persons are grouped, furnishings interwoven, occupants faced toward one another, service set in circulation, and outcomes matched to work. The Event therefore dissolves one arrangement while fixing another.

activation_trace.role: Placement and fixity anchor the changed reading as a second ordering after the fall.
Initial dispersal supplies the disassembled state from which the later order contrasts.
Joining a counterpart supplies the first relational act of recomposition.
Tight interwoven construction supplies material coherence after particulate dispersal.
Mutual facing supplies deliberate social geometry within the new arrangement.
Circulation around the group turns the static arrangement into a maintained system.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the rule by which the new order is allocated.
Intentional work supplies the prior input to the recompensatory arrangement.

structural_cues: The material sequence moves from scattered dust to grouped persons and tightly arranged, circulating relations.
56:24 explicitly relates the resulting provision to prior action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: dispersal, grouping, weaving, facing, circulation, and act-for-recompense matching. Reader: these form a constructive reversal rather than unrelated scene details. Alternative: destruction and reward may be juxtaposed without implying a shared recomposition mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Event ends the old world's arrangement.
changed_reading.after: The Event is a transfer of fixity: it disassembles inherited solidity and establishes a relational order fitted to prior acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audible blow and roar of occurrence are not the final soundscape. Heard mixed noise and culpability-producing speech are excluded until utterance contracts to repeated peace and safety.

activation_trace.role: The trace and sound of hard impact make the focus Event acoustically legible.
The roar of a people or thunder amplifies the Event's opening acoustic violence.
Auditory reception marks the later scene as an explicitly regulated sound field.
Mixed clamorous noise supplies the excluded acoustic residue.
Loading another with guilt supplies the excluded harmful function of speech.
Articulated utterance supplies the sole positive content left after acoustic clearance.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the semantic endpoint of the transformed soundscape.
Peace opposed to war reverses the impact register with a relationally pacified one.

structural_cues: 56:25 uses coordinated negation, while 56:26 uses exception and repeats the only retained utterance.
The context moves from impact noise to selective hearing and finally to speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: impact-sound, roar, negated heard noise and blame, then repeated peace-speech. Reader: these points form an acoustic arc governed by the Event. Alternative: the final speech may describe only one reward scene without retrospectively transforming the opening impact.

changed_reading.before: The Event announces itself as a crushing sound.
changed_reading.after: The Event opens a passage from violent impact through acoustic purification to speech whose only force is peace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق و ع target attached to the focus root. It remains anchored by that explicit split inventory and by the context's earth-mountain-dust sequence. Render it only as an exploratory terrain analogy, not as a replacement etymology for الواقعة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence resolves not only to و ق ع but also to the packet's ق و ع target, whose level open surface can be tested against the following terrain sequence.

activation_trace.role: An extended level surface supplies the strange but packet-authorized endpoint of the focus occurrence.
The terrestrial lower surface supplies the field on which leveling can become visible.
Elevated solid masses supply the vertical forms that must disappear for a level field to emerge.
Fine scattered dust supplies the leveled field's deconstructed material.

changed_reading.before: The Event is a catastrophe occurring on the earth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Event is also the exposure of a level field when vertical solidity is reduced to dispersed matter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading depends on the rain branch of و ق ع and the non-dominant cutting/ripeness target of ج ز ي. It remains anchored by focus occurrence, fruit, selection, recompense, and work. Render it as a seasonal harvest analogy for consequence, not as the event's primary lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's rainfall branch allows the occurrence to initiate a material cycle whose context later names fruit, selection, work, and recompense.

activation_trace.role: Falling rain supplies the seasonal input that makes a harvest-cycle analogy possible.
Pleasant fruit supplies the matured yield of the analogy.
Choosing the good supplies selective gathering rather than undifferentiated abundance.
Ripeness and the time of cutting supply the harvest threshold through the cue's non-dominant mapped root.
Intentional work supplies the cultivated input whose consequence is gathered.

changed_reading.before: The Event arrives as catastrophe and is followed by reward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Event is harvest-time: cultivated consequences reach ripeness, are selected, and are apportioned.

strongest_changes: The opening changed from generic futurity into an irreversible crossing from expectation to fixed actuality.
Lowering, raising, and threefold grouping made the Event a differential allocator of position and rank.
Earth-to-dust and dispersal-to-weaving sequences made the Event both substrate failure and transfer into a newly composed order.
The sound branches opened a secondary arc from impact and roar to the repeated speech of peace.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled focus root supported actualization, placement, impact, rainfall, and a split level-ground target; the ordered context made those images operate as temporal threshold, rank assignment, material phase change, recomposition, and acoustic clearance without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The lowering-raising pair may govern terrain, social rank, or both.
The recomposition model may be a causal reversal or only a strong contextual juxtaposition.
The terrain and harvest outliers rely on split or branch-distant mappings and should remain explicitly exploratory.
